name: Fraser Valley Spring Open 2018

venue.name: [Fort Langley Evangelical Free Church](https://www.flefc.org/)
venue.address: 8870 Glover Road, Fort Langley, BC, Canada V1M 2K1
venue.details: The competition will be located in the gym.

information:
Speedcubing has at last come to the township of Langley! We look forward to a full house of 90 competitive cubers on Saturday April 7th, 2018!

Canadian or USD cash is required at the competition for those wishing to eat on site at our handy concession.

Calling for additional help: Those previously experienced as scramblers, judges and runners willing to gift some of their time on April 7th are asked to e-mail [Lindy](mailto:lindy@flefc.org) to commit to volunteering for a portion of the day!

**A second registration period will open on Saturday, March 3rd, at 10 AM (Pacific Time).**
